title: Allotment.
bodyText: Contracts to expend and appropriations for the purchase of health and human services shall be subject to the allotment system generally applicable to all appropriations made by the legislature.
bodyHtml: [§103F-414]  Allotment.  Contracts to expend and appropriations for the purchase of health and human services shall be subject to the allotment system generally applicable to all appropriations made by the legislature. [L 1997, c 190, pt of §2]
